content_name: QA Laminate vs Vinyl Plank What Is the Difference

actions.caption:
Laminate vs vinyl plank. They look identical, and one of them will fail in your basement.

Laminate has a wood-fiber (HDF) core. Warmer and slightly softer underfoot, and the most realistic wood look you can get.
Vinyl plank is 100% polymer. Fully waterproof. Spill on it, leave it, it doesn't care.

Dry rooms: laminate.
Anywhere water can happen (kitchens, basements, bathrooms): vinyl plank.

That's the whole decision.
